addedFailureStages.case: publication collision preserves predecessor and complete partial
addedFailureStages.finding: Actual File.Move collision occurs after retained partial copy/readback. Complete partial digest, collision sentinel, old archive and all old manifest/payload/sentinel bytes are checked; actual Install caller falls back with no clipboard handoff.

addedFailureStages.case: mid-extraction failure preserves predecessor and blocks actual handoff
addedFailureStages.finding: Second actual member-file creation throws after the first manifest is on disk; extraction-failed record has no ready path; actual Install caller falls back; old archive/all old files remain equal.

addedFailureStages.case: complete archive preflight precedes every delegated member writer
addedFailureStages.finding: Direct actual archive validator sees late traversal member; delegated directory/file creation boundaries record zero member writers after root allocation, and root stays empty. Healthy valid ZIP/caller remains paired.

disposition: No additional blocker in this bounded driver/case delta. Eight supplemental mechanisms discriminate exact failures and useful paired controls.
